summary: First full test run of G-14 Aether Wave HUD simulator. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (telemetry POST valid/invalid/missing/non-object, latest, stream status, WS publisher->subscriber relay incl. junk/invalid frame filtering and subscriber-send ignored, unreal files=9 with content, kit.zip with 9 entries under G14Hud/). Frontend: all requested flows verified on desktop 1920x1080 — Calm HUD (all slots, E-01/E-02, CONSCIOUSNESS STABLE, stable-zone shown), Combat (4 entities, COMBAT, TARGET LOCK, throttle T1), Overload (5 entities, OBSERVER THROTTLE T2, stable-zone gone, compass/radar opacity 0.12, stasis 0.35), sliders via keyboard update values/HUD and set CUSTOM, yaw moves compass heading 000->010, all 5 layer toggles hide/show slots, throttling off removes indicator and restores opacity, scanlines toggle, data feed JSON with correct schema/sensors, stream toggle -> STREAMING + LIVE indicator, backend publishers=1 and frames increasing, in-browser WS subscriber received 17 frames, /api/telemetry/latest returns SIMULATOR frame, toggle off -> OFFLINE and publishers=0. Unreal page: 9 files, default file G14TelemetryReceiver.cpp, click updates path, copy toast, download works, zip href correct, schema table 17 rows, 4 endpoints correct. No page errors.

issues: Stasis meter Japanese sub-label shows '意識不安定' (unstable) for both DRIFTING and UNSTABLE states - cosmetic
hud-system-line SEQ stays 00000 while not streaming (seq only increments on send) - cosmetic

action_items: Optional: in useSimulation, if the WS closes unexpectedly (server restart/network) the Stream toggle stays ON but status shows OFFLINE with no reconnect; consider auto-reconnect or resetting the toggle
Optional: Japanese label for DRIFTING state
critical_code_review_comments: useSimulation.js: ws.onclose does not set streaming=false or reconnect -> toggle/status mismatch after unexpected disconnect
server.py: /unreal/kit.zip calls read_kit() synchronously in the event loop (files endpoint uses asyncio.to_thread) - minor inconsistency
server.py: hub.publish sends to subscribers sequentially; a slow subscriber blocks the publisher loop - acceptable for MVP
Anyone can connect with ?role=publisher (no auth) - acceptable per no-auth requirement but worth noting for real helmet deployment
seed_data_creation: None. Test POSTs telemetry frames with source TEST_ (in-memory hub only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hub state is in-memory (frames/latest). Python urllib to the public URL gets 403 (UA blocked) - use requests or page.request. Radix slider: focus [role=slider] inside slider-* testid and press arrows/PageUp. Disable toggle-auto-sway before checking yaw heading. Mobile/tablet layout not tested.
